Run GO-ORA Overlap Networks for All Clusters in a Comparison

run_comparison_networks.Rd

Iterates over every cluster in a named list of GO enrichment results, builds a Jaccard-overlap network of enriched GO terms, applies Leiden community detection, and saves network plots and summary tables. Clusters that lack enrichment results or have fewer than two significant pathways are skipped with a message. With split_direction = TRUE, a separate network is built for the up- and down-regulated results of each cluster.

Usage

run_comparison_networks(
  go_list,
  de_list,
  comp_label,
  base_outdir,
  overlap_threshold = 0.1,
  leiden_resolution = 1,
  objective_function = c("modularity", "CPM"),
  seed = 1234,
  split_direction = FALSE,
  zscore_threshold = 1,
  theme_label = c("ancestor", "keywords", "phrase", "hub"),
  theme_min_terms = 3,
  theme_n_words = 3,
  theme_ancestor_min_share = 0.15,
  theme_ancestor_max_size = 1000,
  theme_max_ancestors = 2
)

Arguments

go_list

A named list of GO results from run_go_ora. With split_direction = FALSE, each element is a single enrichResult; with split_direction = TRUE, each element is a list with $up and $down enrichResult objects. Names must match the names in de_list.

de_list

The output of run_cluster_de: a named list whose elements each contain a $degs data frame with at least the columns gene (gene symbol) and avg_log2FC.

comp_label

Character string identifying the comparison (e.g., "CD206_Car_vs_Bleo"). Used to build output sub-directory paths and as a prefix in plot titles.

base_outdir

Character path to the root output directory. A sub-directory <comp_label>/networks/ is created automatically.

overlap_threshold

Numeric [0, 1]. Minimum Jaccard overlap between two GO term gene sets required to draw an edge. Default 0.1.

leiden_resolution

Numeric. Resolution for Leiden clustering. With the default modularity objective, values around 1 are standard; higher values give more, smaller clusters. Use plot_leiden_sweep to choose a value. Default 1.

objective_function

Character. Leiden objective passed to igraph::cluster_leiden: "modularity" (default; resolution is comparable across networks) or "CPM" (constant Potts model; resolution acts as an edge-density cutoff and needs much smaller values, e.g. 0.03).

seed

Integer seed for Leiden clustering and the plot layout, so results are reproducible. It does not change the random state of your session. NULL disables seeding. Default 1234.

split_direction

Logical. Set to TRUE when go_list comes from run_go_ora(split_direction = TRUE). Each direction is then built from its own results and only the DEGs in that direction (avg_log2FC > 0 for up, < 0 for down). Must match the structure of go_list; a mismatch is an error. Default FALSE.

zscore_threshold

Numeric. Passed to generate_overlap_network: nodes with a direction z-score of at least this value are called up, at most minus this value down, and mixed otherwise. Default 1.

theme_label

Character. Text used to label each cluster in the themes plot:

"ancestor" (default)

Up to theme_max_ancestors higher-level GO terms that the cluster's terms fall under in the GO hierarchy (via GO.db), with how many of the cluster's terms they cover, e.g. "cytokine production / response to cytokine (22/39)". Each is chosen to cover many of the remaining terms while staying specific. Falls back to the hub term when no ancestor qualifies or the results have no GO IDs.

"keywords"

The most distinctive words in the cluster's term names.

"phrase"

The top term name, as used by the wordclouds.

"hub"

The cluster's most connected term.

theme_min_terms

Integer. Clusters with fewer terms get a hull but no callout label in the themes plot, to limit clutter. They are still listed colour-coded in the cluster legend. Default 3.

theme_n_words

Integer. Number of keywords per cluster label when theme_label = "keywords". Default 3.

theme_ancestor_min_share

Numeric (0, 1]. Minimum share of a cluster's terms an ancestor must cover to be used as a label. Default 0.15.

theme_ancestor_max_size

Integer. GO terms with more descendants than this are considered too generic to be a label (for reference: "cell cycle" has about 800, "response to stress" about 1,300, "cellular process" about 16,000). Default 1000.

theme_max_ancestors

Integer. Maximum number of ancestors in one cluster label. Default 2.

Value

A flat named list of network result lists, one per network that could be built. Each element is the list returned by generate_overlap_network. Names are the cluster names (with "/" replaced by "_"), plus a "_up" or "_down" suffix when split_direction = TRUE.

Output files

Files are written to <base_outdir>/<comp_label>/networks/ with the file stem <cluster> (or <cluster>_up / <cluster>_down when split). See generate_overlap_network for the file list.

See also
